title: Bank Imaging Administrator
description:

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Working Hours: Monday to Sunday between 07:30 and 20:00
Essential Requirement: Candidates must be available to work Friday

Contract Type:- Bank

Benefits

Working on our Bank gives you the flexibility to fit work around your other commitments whilst remaining connected to a professional healthcare environment and developing your experience within a leading independent hospital.

Our Bank colleagues benefit from:
- Competitive hourly rates, paid weekly.
- Flexible shifts to support your work-life balance.
- Access to the Spire Healthcare pension scheme.
- Blue Light Card discounts.
- Free DBS and uniform.
- Comprehensive induction and mandatory training.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.

- Previous experience in an administrative, purchasing, procurement or supply chain support role is desirable.
- Strong communication and teamwork skills.
- Well organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy.

title: Training Course Coordination Administrator
description:
Training Course Coordination Administrator

Why do we want you

Astutis (part of Wilmington plc) is looking for a highly organised and customer-focused individual who is passionate about delivering an exceptional learner experience.

In this role, you'll act as a key point of contact for learners throughout their qualification journey, providing support from registration and course access through to assessment, examination and certification.

You'll be confident managing multiple priorities, coordinating examination processes, maintaining accurate learner records and ensuring communications are delivered clearly and professionally to both learners and stakeholders.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy helping people succeed, proactively supporting learners at key milestones, answering queries and ensuring they have the guidance, resources and encouragement needed to achieve their qualifications.

Please note: To complete your application, you will be redirected to Wilmington plc s career site.

At Wilmington plc, we celebrate individuality and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. As a Disability Confident employer, we shortlist all applicants who meet the essential role criteria and guarantee an interview for candidates with disabilities who meet these criteria. For reasonable adjustments or to apply under our interview guarantee scheme, please use the contact details provided once you have clicked apply !

Job purpose, tasks and responsibilities

You will be responsible for:
- Support online learners throughout their learning journey.
- Manage exam registrations, bookings, scheduling and communications.
- Guide learners through assessment and exam milestones.
- Deliver against SLAs, KPIs and learner administration deadlines.
- Build strong relationships with Sales Account Managers to deliver an excellent learner experience.
- Act as the main point of contact for learners from enrolment through to certification.
- Support learners requiring additional help, re-sits or extensions.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes and best practice.
- Maintain accurate learner records using internal systems and technology.
- Deliver exceptional customer service in all communications.
- Provide team support and cover during busy periods and colleague absences.

What's the Best Thing About This Role

You will have the opportunity to directly influence learner success.

You'll be more than an administrator or coordinator; you'll become a trusted point of contact, supporting people from registration through to certification.

Seeing learners overcome challenges, pass their assessments and achieve their qualifications provides a genuine sense of purpose and achievement, while working within a customer-focused team dedicated to delivering an exceptional learning experience.

What s the Most Challenging Thing About This Role

Successfully managing multiple learners, deadlines and stakeholder requirements at the same time while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

The role requires someone who can switch between responding to learner queries, coordinating examinations, updating systems, working with awarding bodies, and supporting internal teams, all while ensuring every learner receives a high level of personalised support.

Essential and desirable capabilities

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, client support, operations, coordination, or administration role.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
- Solid understanding and knowledge of customer service principles and standards.
- Knowledge of principles and practices of Sales, and how this relates to after-sales customer support and care.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
- Experience using CRM or administrative systems.
- A customer-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service.
- Ability to build positive relationships with customers, learners, and internal stakeholders.

It would be great if you had:
- Experience working within a training, learning, education, or professional services environment.
- Understanding of training and professional certification processes.
- Familiarity with awarding bodies such as NEBOSH, IOSH, or IEMA.
- Experience supporting key accounts or managing a client portfolio.
- Knowledge of post-sales customer support and customer success principles.
- We know it s not a skill, but the successful candidate must have permission to work in the role s location by the start of their employment.

Before you go

About us

Astutis is a market leader in workplace health, safety, and environmental training, helping organisations create safer, healthier work environments. As part of Wilmington plc, we are committed to delivering high-quality courses and outstanding customer service.

Join us and do Work That Means Something

At Wilmington plc, we help global customers to do the right business in the right way - providing trusted data, insights, and education to navigate the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) landscape.

When you join us, you ll not only make a real difference for our customers, you ll also enjoy flexibility through hybrid working and benefit from a wide range of learning, career, and development opportunities.

Whether you're just starting out, returning to work after a break, or looking to take your next step, you ll be doing work with meaning.

Join us and make a real difference. Click on APPLY today!
